description: Compare a website's AI visibility head-to-head against named competitors. Use this when someone asks "how do I stack up against X and Y," "who does ChatGPT recommend instead of me," or wants a competitive AI-visibility view. Returns each competitor's score and where they appear that the site does not. Each competitor not already cached costs one audit against your daily quota; if the quota can't cover every competitor, it ranks the ones it could audit and returns a `quota` summary plus a `skipped` list naming the rest — it never drops competitors silently or invents scores. If the quota is already exhausted it returns an over-quota error with the reset time. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($49/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.

business_location.description: Optional. The market to compare within, e.g. "Chiang Mai, Thailand". Applied to the site AND every competitor, because a comparison asks about one market — scoring one locally and the others globally would rank answers to two different questions. Leave it out and each audit detects its own location, which is right for national or global businesses and wrong for local ones.

name: compare_competitors

gaps.description: Engines where a competitor appears in AI answers and this site does not.

market.description: The market every audit in this comparison was scored in, or null when each domain's own location was detected.

audits_skipped.description: Competitors skipped because the daily quota ran out.

audits_used.description: Fresh audits actually spent by this call.

cached_reused.description: Domains served from a recent cached audit; cost no quota.

recommendation_gap.description: How far behind the competitor you trail most the site is, each side as a share of its own answers, compared on the assistants that answered for both. Present only when both audits recorded stances; its sentence reads the result back in one line.

assistants.description: The assistants the figures are over: those that answered for both sites. Null when that could not be checked.

unverified.description: True when this competitor's business name could not be verified.

you_answers.description: Your answers on the same basis as this competitor's figures.

you_recommended.description: Your recommended answers on the same basis as this competitor's figures.

gap_points.description: Positive when the top competitor is recommended more often.

not_compared.description: Competitors left out because their audit recorded no stances.

rival.description: The competitor you trail most (when you lead every competitor, the one you lead least), compared on the assistants that answered for both sites.

same_questions.description: Whether both audits asked the same set of questions; null when either did not record them.

tied_with.description: Other competitors with identical counts over the identical basis: one gap, all named.

title: Compare against competitors
